scope: One bounded deterministic compiler revision in three families. No LLM rewrite, parser ensemble, media inference or relation training.

diagnoses.implemented_remedy: Retain the exact noun phrase in its existing argument role, recording that its internal relations remain unexposed.

limits: The user accepts the passive-progressive simplification for now; that temporal distinction is not changed.
Coarse noun phrases are counted and exposed as coarse arguments, not complete internal parses.
The appositive OR interpretation is declared and remains a context/review requirement.
A reciprocal argument is a neural-predicate input contract, not a newly trained media verifier.
New outputs have not received new human ratings; the original twenty now serve as development diagnostics.
